name: terminal
description: Terminal skills for a coding agent: shared-pane (one WezTerm window the user and the agent both drive, for passwords, MFA and interactive logins), new-warp-chat (open a seeded tab in the running Warp terminal), and breakout (open a fresh chat of the same CLI in a new Warp tab).

interface.shortDescription: Share a WezTerm window for logins, and open seeded chats in new Warp tabs.
interface.longDescription: Skills for working across terminal windows: shared-pane opens one WezTerm window where the user types a password or approves MFA and the agent keeps driving the same authenticated shell; new-warp-chat opens a new tab in the running Warp terminal that runs a command with an optional seed prompt; breakout uses it to open a fresh chat of the same CLI, launched with the flags from the user's own Warp tab configs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Open a fresh chat in a new tab.
